messages:
sara_mkt: Quick note  we wrapped Kitewell's interview. They gave a tight line we like for the case: "Redwood significantly reduced our per-inference cost while keeping latency steady." Need legal and comms OK + webinar routing.

ben_p: Nice. Can you attach the raw clip and paste the verbatim line? I'll then cut a 15s social teaser.

sara_mkt: Verbatim: "Redwood significantly reduced our per-inference cost while keeping latency steady during peak traffic." Audio uploaded to Files.

laura_legal: Suggest avoid numeric absolutes if not written in release. Edit proposal: "significantly reduced per-inference cost while maintaining stable latency". Need PR sign-off and the signed advocacy release before publish.

amy_cs: They signed the standard release. Pinged PR for final wording and attribution.

tom_se: For routing I'll create the SFDC campaign + HubSpot form. Fields: email, company, role, use_case, interest_level, attended_webinar. Webhook to enrichment?

ben_p: Yes add enrichment webhook and utm fields. Campaign name: Kitewell_Case_Q3_24. Tom please post the campaign ID when ready.

amy_cs: PR confirmed the softened quote and provided attribution: "Jordan Lee, VP Platform, Kitewell". They want a link to their public benchmarks repo in the post and no competitor mentions. No embargo.

ops-bot: Publish checklist: release attached, comms approval, SFDC campaign created, assets uploaded.

tom_se: Campaign created: Kitewell_Case_Q3_24 (ID SF-8721). HubSpot form URL: https://info.redwood.ai/kitewell-case. Webhook configured to /enrich.

ben_p: I'll prepare two social headlines and run a short A/B on LinkedIn. Sara please review landing CTA (two options posted in the doc).

sara_mkt: CTA set to "Read the case + register". Landing copy updated and signed release attached. Marking this thread resolved. :tada:
